## Clase Series

```{r}
library(fpp3)
gdppc <- global_economy |>
  mutate(GDP_per_capita = GDP / Population)
```

```{r}
gdppc |>
  filter(Country == "Sweden") |>
  autoplot(GDP_per_capita) +
  labs(x = "Año", y = "$US", title = "PIB per cápita de Suecia")
```

```{r}
fit <- gdppc |>
  model(trend_model = TSLM(GDP_per_capita ~ trend()))
```

```{r}
fit |> forecast(h = "3 years")
```

```{r}
fit |>
  forecast(h = "3 years") |>
  filter(Country == "Sweden") |>
  autoplot(gdppc) +
  labs(x = "Año", y = "$US", title = "PIB per cápita de Suecia") +
  guides(fill_ramp = guide_legend(title = "Nivel"))
```

## Métodos

```{r}
bricks <- aus_production |>
  filter_index("1970 Q1" ~ "2004 Q4") |>
  select(Bricks)
```

```{r}
bricks |> model(MEAN(Bricks)) ->fit_mean
```

```{r}
fit_mean |>
  forecast(h = "5 years") |>
  autoplot(bricks) 

```

```{r}
fit2 <- bricks |>
  model(trend_model = TSLM(Bricks ~ trend()))
```

```{r}
fit2 |>
  forecast(h = "5 years") |>
  autoplot(bricks) 

  
```

```{r}

```

```{r}
fit3 <- bricks |> model(NAIVE(Bricks))
fit3 |>
  forecast(h = "5 years") |>
  autoplot(bricks) 
```

```{r}
ft <- bricks |> model(trend_model = TSLM(Bricks ~ trend()),MEAN(Bricks),NAIVE(Bricks))
ft|>forecast(h = "5 years") |>autoplot(bricks)
```

```{r}
fit4 <- bricks |> model(SNAIVE(Bricks ~ lag("2 year")))
fit4 |>forecast(h = "5 years") |>autoplot(bricks)
```

## Drift

```{r}
fit5 <- bricks |> model(NAIVE(Bricks),RW(Bricks ~ drift()))
fit5 |>forecast(h = "15 years") |>autoplot(bricks,level=NULL)

```

```{r}
# Set training data from 1992 to 2006
train <- aus_production |>
  filter_index("1992 Q1" ~ "2006 Q4")
# Fit the models
beer_fit <- train |>
  model(
    Media = MEAN(Beer),
    `Naïve` = NAIVE(Beer),
    `Naïve estacional` = SNAIVE(Beer)
  )
# Generate forecasts for 14 quarters
beer_fc <- beer_fit |> forecast(h = 14)
# Plot forecasts against actual values
beer_fc |>
  autoplot(train, level = NULL) +
  autolayer(
    filter_index(aus_production, "2007 Q1" ~ .),
    colour = "black"
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Trimestre",
    y = "Megalitros",
    title = "Predicciones de la producción trimestral de cerveza"
  ) +
  guides(colour = guide_legend(title = "Predicción"))
```

```{r}
# Re-index based on trading days
google_stock <- gafa_stock |>
  filter(Symbol == "GOOG", year(Date) >= 2015) |>
  mutate(day = row_number()) |>
  update_tsibble(index = day, regular = TRUE)
# Filter the year of interest
google_2015 <- google_stock |> filter(year(Date) == 2015)
# Fit the models
google_fit <- google_2015 |>
  model(
    Media = MEAN(Close),
    `Naïve` = NAIVE(Close),
    Deriva = NAIVE(Close ~ drift())
  )
# Produce forecasts for the trading days in January 2016
google_jan_2016 <- google_stock |>
  filter(yearmonth(Date) == yearmonth("2016 Jan"))
google_fc <- google_fit |>
  forecast(new_data = google_jan_2016)
# Plot the forecasts
google_fc |>
  autoplot(google_2015) +
  autolayer(google_jan_2016, Close, colour = "black") +
  labs(
    x = "Día de negociación",
    y = "$US",
    title = "Precios de cierre diarios de las acciones de Google",
    subtitle = "(ene 2015 - ene 2016)"
  ) +
  guides(colour = guide_legend(title = "Predicción"))
```
